title: A red-cell size–dispersion interaction fails to improve low-ferritin prediction beyond flexible CBC measures in a separate NHANES sample
abstract: In 1,006 complete-case NHANES 2005–2006 nonpregnant women aged 20–49, an MCV-by-RDW product failed to improve low-ferritin prediction beyond flexible CBC measures: weighted Brier gain -0.00029936 (95% source/target PSU refit interval -0.00273470 to +0.00075673).
